metadata.title: Bulk RNA-seq analysis of G2019S LRRK2 knockin primary astrocytes
metadata.description: Primary astrocytes were isolated from P1 G2019S LRRK2 knockin pups and their wildtype littermates. The cells were treated either with Etoposide(20uM) or vehicle at 18 days in vitro; cells were collected at 24 days in vitro (n=3/group). Total RNA was isolated from cell pellets, then subjected to bulk RNA-seq.
references: Aligning Science Across Parkinson's Collaborative Research Network Cloud, https://cloud.parkinsonsroadmap.org/collections, RRID:SCR_023923
